_meta.title: Switzerland: police-recorded offences of discrimination and incitement to hatred (Art. 261bis), by canton
_meta.measures: Offences recorded by the police under Swiss Criminal Code Art. 261bis (racial discrimination; since 2020 also discrimination for sexual orientation, renamed 'discrimination and incitement to hatred') and Art. 261 (disturbing freedom of faith and worship), per canton and year 2009-2025, split into completed/attempted and solved/unsolved. 'value' = Art. 261bis offences (total) in the latest year. 'Schweiz' total kept without geometry.
_meta.source: Bundesamt für Statistik (BFS), Polizeiliche Kriminalstatistik (PKS), table px-x-1903020100_101
